parsed.rationale: V1–V3 show deep QS complexes with marked convex ST-segment elevation (tombstone morphology) and ST elevation also extends to V4, which meets STEMI criteria for acute anterior STEMI, with a regular rhythm and baseline noise in the limb leads.
